snippet.title: CAPGRAS - OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
CAPGRAS is a story-driven RPG horror game using RPG Maker VX Ace, features classic RPG horror gameplay mechanics and experiences. Coming out in October 3rd.

Story:
It begins with a young woman who recently bought a new house in downtown, where she finds a weird board game named "Finding Treasures". She decides to play it alone. When she plays, strange phenomena starts happening in her house that eventually drives her into endless madness. 

Check out the link below for more details:
https://kemonoproject.itch.io/capgras
